clauses.quote: Teachers in a temporary status may be advanced sick leave in amounts equal to anticipated sick leave accruals during their temporary appointments.
A request for advanced leave must be submitted and approved in writing at least five (5) days prior to the absence.
clauses.notes: Procedural submission requirement imposed on teachers.

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be permitted to use hourly leave in one (1) hour and two (2) hour increments.
DCPS and the WTU shall mutually agree on the format for the use of hourly leave
use of hourly leave shall be implemented no later than the beginning of the 2010-2011 school year.
Teachers who have perfect attendance (no absences and no use of sick leave during a given school year) shall have the right to return to DCPS all of the sick leave they accrued during the year.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who have perfect attendance (no absences and no use of sick leave during a given school year)

clauses.quote: A Teacher may elect to return to DCPS one half (1/2) of the sick leave days accrued but not taken during the current year at the current daily rate of pay.
Unreturned sick leave shall be credited each year to the Teacher’s sick leave balance
and shall not be subject to the Sick Leave Buy-Back Plan.
clauses.notes: Independent clause split from preceding sentence; subject repeated for clarity.

clauses.quote: Teachers who return accrued sick leave in accordance with Sections 17.1.11.1 and 17.1.11.2 above shall be compensated at the daily rate of pay that corresponds to their annual salary.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who return accrued sick leave in accordance with Sections 17.1.11.1 and 17.1.11.2 above

clauses.quote: All unused and unreturned sick leave shall be carried forward from year to year.
clauses.subject_text: All unused and unreturned sick leave

clauses.quote: A Teacher “Sick Leave Bank” shall be operated under guidelines approved by DCPS and the WTU.
Teachers shall have the right to donate one (1) day of their sick leave per year to the “Sick Leave Bank.”

In addition, starting in school year 2025-2026, DCPS agrees to deposit sick leave hours as necessary to maintain a minimum balance of 10,000 hours of leave in WTU’s Sick Leave Bank by October 1 of each school year, provided WTU certifies the Sick Leave Bank balance at the beginning of the school year.
DCPS and WTU will collaborate to modify any existing policy or guidelines to the extent necessary to effectuate this provision.
A Teacher “Maternity/Paternity Leave Bank” shall be operated under guidelines approved by DCPS and the WTU.
Retiring Teachers who have excess leave days following their retirement calculation shall have the right to donate the excess leave days
clauses.subject_text: Retiring Teachers who have excess leave days following their retirement calculation
